headline: ASTEROIDS plays itself: the hunter takes the wheel
lede: Batch 26 of the WATCH rollout seats a proven driver on the oldest unguarded title on the shelf. The whole 1979 rule set — drift, wrap, the 40-to-20-to-10 split chain, respawn grace, wave regen — now lives in one pure sim, and the driver the harness certifies is exactly what you watch at 60 fps.

notes.text: The first driver stalled beside the last rock forever: one-tick rollouts tie, fleeing pebbles that never arrive wastes seconds, and rotation is too coarse to hit a distant pebble. The fixes were all geometry: hold every candidate 10 ticks before handing to greedy, dodge only what actually arrives (quadratic time-to-collision), and lead the target — fire only when the rock's angular size swallows the quantized aim.
Sweep: 40 seeds x 120 s, byte-equal replays on all 40, zero game-overs, 35 zero-death runs, waves 2-4, worst seed banks 6,560 points.
asteroidscheck now ships a 12-mutant battery including the driver itself: muted seat, lingering seat, suicidal rollout and ghost-aim all die. Asteroids also joined the __game contract fleet (14/14).
Seat law unchanged: Y or the pill seats with the shared blips, any other key/pad/tap takes over, and a new run always starts in your hands.

look.text: Watch the hunter clear a field — press Y (or the green pill) at jalfern.com…
